subject: IAM evidence request & SOC 2 status - Ceres Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cereshealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: IAM evidence request & SOC 2 status - Ceres Health

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can keep procurement moving:

What we heard
- Ceres is evaluating Redwood for patient data workloads (HIPAA scoped).
- Primary concerns: SSO/SAML integration, SCIM provisioning for user sync, RBAC and admin controls, audit logging/retention, and SOC 2 evidence.

Immediate asks (can you help with):
1) SOC 2: do you have a copy of your SOC 2 Type II or a SOC summary we can reference? If not, can you confirm estimated availability?
2) SSO: who will be our technical contact for SAML metadata and IdP config? If you can share SAML metadata (entityID, ACS URL, cert) or a test assertion that speeds validation, that would be ideal.
3) SCIM: sample SCIM endpoints or a provisioning guide (schema, attribute mapping).
4) Admin controls: list of admin roles (superadmin, org-admin), whether RBAC mapping is available, and if there are audit log exports we can access for attestations.

Next steps from Redwood
- I’m attaching a short SOC 2 summary and a couple of SSO config snippets that usually help speed implementation.
- I’ll kick off a short vendor security questionnaire and send it to the security contact you confirm — that will capture the bulk of evidence we need.
- Aditya (SE) and Dev (SRE) are copied to help with any technical deep-dive.

Suggested timeline: if Ceres can share the SAML metadata + SCIM doc by next Tue (8/18), Aditya and Dev can validate and we’ll get a formal IMS evidence packet back to you within 3 business days.

Questions? Otherwise I’ll send the questionnaire and a HubSpot link for uploading docs.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, sso-config-snippets.png

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cereshealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@cereshealth.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IAM evidence request & SOC 2 status - Ceres Health

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below:

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report in process; expected completion 09/10/2026. In the meantime, attaching our vendor security questionnaire (initial draft) — we can also provide a SOC summary signed by our compliance lead.
- SSO: I’m copying our security alias but primary technical contact for SSO is me. I can share the SAML metadata and a test assertion. We use Okta as the IdP.
- SCIM: We have SCIM v2 endpoints; I’ll pull our provisioning guide and sample API responses for you.
- Admin controls/logs: we can export admin role mappings and an audit log sample (redacted).

I’m attaching the filled VSQ starter and will coordinate with security@cereshealth.com on final delivery.

Let us know if you need anything else to keep the procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Senior IT Project Manager
Ceres Health
alex.johnson@cereshealth.com
(202) 555-0789

Attachments: ceres_vsq.docx

Alex —

Perfect, thanks for the fast turnaround. Looping Aditya and Dev to pick up the technical items.

Action items / proposed plan:
- Alex: please upload the SAML metadata + test assertion and the SCIM guide to the HubSpot deal link (or reply-all with attachments) by EOD Tue 8/18.
- Aditya: once we have metadata, can you validate ACS/EntityID and confirm whether we need any custom attribute mapping for SCIM?
- Dev: when Aditya confirms, please prepare: (a) sample audit log export (redacted) showing admin changes, (b) a short note on RBAC mapping options (JSON examples helpful).

I’ll send the formal VSQ to security@cereshealth.com and include the HubSpot upload instructions. If preferred, we can set a 30-min technical sync on Wed 8/19 — propose 10:00 AM PT.

HubSpot upload: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/78912
VSQ: https://docs.google.com/document/d/ceres-iam-checklist

Thanks again — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Marissa
